implementation.targetScope: Synchronous byte/string/object streams for current glob and path-scurry file discovery, with backpressure, collectors, async iteration and abort cleanup.

differences: Own queue with a head cursor and bounded compaction; no runtime package dependencies.
Pending iterator return resolves the pending next operation and removes listeners.
No debugExposeBuffer private-symbol introspection. Internal EventEmitter/decoder scheduling is independently implemented; exact asynchronous microtask ordering is not claimed.
No application override, deployment or complete tar/npm toolchain migration is claimed.
